expected.valueText: Treatment directly arising from or consequent upon an Insured Person committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent is excluded.

expected.valueText: Cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance is excluded.
exceptions: Reconstruction following an Accident, Burn(s) or Cancer
Medically necessary treatment to remove a direct and immediate health risk, certified by the attending Medical Practitioner

expected.valueText: Unproven treatments, services and supplies are excluded; unproven means lacking significant medical documentation to support effectiveness.

expected.valueText: Policy void and all premium forfeited for misrepresentation, mis-description or non-disclosure of any material fact by the policyholder. Material facts are all relevant information sought in the proposal form and connected documents for underwriting.
expected.quote: The Policy shall be void and all premium paid thereon shall be forfeited to the Company in the event of misrepresentation, mis-description or non-disclosure of any material fact by the policyholder.
